title_sq: Apartament - Për Shitje - Rruga Ali Demi, Tiranë (ID: 530551001-145)
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 2+1+2 tualete+2 ballkone ne fillim te rr, Ali Demii ngjitur me shkollen 1 Maji!
Lokacioni strategjik perben avantazh ,pasi eshte ngjitur me unazen e vogel te qytetit,me akses te menjehershem ne linjat e urbanit.Qendra e qytetit arrihet ne me pak se 5 min ne kembe.
Zona i ofron te gjitha sherbimet ,ka treg fruta perimesh ngjitur,furra buke,shkolla publike dhe te gjitha sherbimet e mundshme qe duhen per nje jete komode.
Hapsira e bollshme e apartamentit ofron mundesine e ndarjes ne dy apartamente duke e bere shume te favorshme dhe per biznes ose qera ditore.

title_en: Apartment - For Sale - Ali Demi Street, Tirana (ID: 530551001-145)
description_en: 2+1+2 bathrooms+2 balconies apartment for sale at the beginning of Ali Demii street, next to the 1 Maji school! The strategic location is an advantage, as it is adjacent to the small ring of the city, with immediate access to the urban lines. The city center can be reached in less than 5 minutes on foot. The area offers all services, there is an adjacent fruit and vegetable market, bakeries, public schools and all possible services needed for a comfortable life. The ample space of the apartment offers the possibility of dividing it into two apartments, making it very favorable for business or daily rent. It is located on the 3rd floor of a building built in 2002, without an elevator, but which is expected to be installed within the year 2025. Total area 102 m2. It has a regular mortgage document. It is also available for buyers with credit. It is currently rented. For a visit to the property, contact us.
